morning_evening.arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الَّذِي لَا يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِي السَّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
morning_evening.translation: In the Name of Allah, with Whose Name there is protection against every kind of harm in the earth or in the heaven, and He is the All-Hearing and All-Knowing.

morning_evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ، وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
morning_evening.translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the morning, and by Your leave we have reached the evening, and by Your leave we live and die, and unto You is the resurrection.

protection.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
protection.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of that which He has created.

protection.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ ۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
protection.translation: Sufficient for me is Allah; there is no deity except Him. On Him I have relied, and He is the Lord of the great Throne.

study_success.translation: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

study_success.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلًا مُتَقَبَّلًا
study_success.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.

travel.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
travel.translation: Glory be to Him Who has subjected this to us, for we could not have mastered it ourselves. And indeed, to Our Lord we will surely return.
